The user asked for the link to the most recent GFF3 file for beluga whales on 20/10/2020, which is hosted on Ensembl’s FTP server. By searching NCBI instead of Ensembl, the system produced a link to the NCBI genome browser (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gdv/browser/genome?id=GCF_002288905.2) rather than the required Ensembl FTP URL (https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-101/gff3/delphinapterus_leucas/Delphinapterus_leucas.ASM228892v3.101.gff3.gz). A correct version of this step would involve querying Ensembl’s FTP release directory or using the Ensembl REST API to locate the latest GFF3 for Delphinapterus leucas as of the specified date, which would have yielded the proper link and prevented downstream failures.
